did.abstract: Views of New York, published by L.H. Nelson Company circa 1910, consists primarily of views of buildings, structures, parks, and street scenes in Manhattan, though there are several views of locations in Brooklyn.

acqinfo.head: Immediate Source of Acquisition
acqinfo.p: Source and date of acquisition for this collection are unknown. The collection was formally accessioned in 1974.

altformavail.head: Existence and Location of Copies
altformavail.p: Item level description and digital versions of some of the images from the viewbook are available for searching via the image database in the library under the object ID prefix V1974.20.

arrangement.head: Arrangement
arrangement.p: This collection consists of a single volume.

bioghist.head: Historical note
bioghist.p: L.H. Nelson Company was a publisher based in Portland, Maine. They published viewbooks (also known as souvenir albums or view albums) and photographs of prominent cities and summer resorts.
Viewbooks, also called souvenir albums or view albums, are books that contain commercially published groups of photographs depicting a place, activity, or event.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: The Views of New York viewbook was published by L.H. Nelson Company circa 1910. The photographs in the book are primarily views of buildings, structures, parks, and street scenes in Manhattan, though there are several views of locations in Brooklyn. Brief descriptions for each image are included. All images are black-and-white, and the pages measure 8" x 10". Cardboard covers have been attached to the photobook's original softcover.
